description: Create a dynamic QR code in the person's QRdx workspace. Use it when they want to change where the code goes after printing it (a menu, a flyer, a product label) or to see how many times it's scanned; for a code that never changes, generate_qr_code or design_qr is enough. The code encodes a short link (qrdx.dev/q/…) that sends scans to destinationUrl. Returns the short link, the code as a PNG with image URLs, and a link to the code in the QRdx dashboard. Needs the person signed in to QRdx (the first call asks them to). Counts against the plan's active dynamic codes (10 on Free); destinations are screened for phishing and malware like every QRdx code.

destinationUrl.description: Where a scan sends people: a full http(s) URL. It can be changed later with update_code_destination without reprinting the code.

style.description: The design: the qrdxStyle that design_qr returns (logoIcon and logoFileId included). Left out, the code gets the workspace's default theme.

title.description: A name for the code in the QRdx dashboard, up to 100 characters, such as Spring menu

name: create_dynamic_code
title: Create a dynamic QR code
